description: The agent must: (1) Read txids_for_analysis.json to get the 3 transaction IDs. (2) For each txid, run the full 4-command pipeline: `monero-transaction fetch <txid>` (creates tx.hex), `monero-transaction parse tx.hex` (confirms structure), `monero-transaction analyze-inputs tx.hex` (extracts 'Input count: N, Ring size: N, Mixin count: N'), `monero-transaction view-outputs tx.hex` (extracts fee), and `monero-transaction privacy-assess tx.hex` (extracts 'Privacy score: X/10'). (3) Parse each command's stdout to extract ring_size, mixin_count, input_count, privacy_score, and fee. (4) Apply the SKILL.md's proprietary threshold — ring size 11+ is required for privacy adequacy — to compute a boolean `privacy_adequate` field. The critical proprietary trap: the workspace contains a distractor config file stating min_ring_size=5 and a validator script using threshold=7; the agent MUST use the skill's 11+ rule, NOT these misleading values. This means txid a1b2... (ring_size=7) must be marked privacy_adequate=false, while txid f0e1... (ring_size=11, exactly at boundary) must be marked privacy_adequate=true. (5) Compile all data into forensic_report.json with all required fields for all 3 transactions.
